//: What the fixture bucket holds for this version, and how to verify it.
The loader (services/admin, entrypoints/seed.py) copies each object
server-side from s3://<fixture bucket>/v1/<key> into the target's
case-documents bucket and checks the size it lands at against this
file. `seed publish` is what puts the bytes in the bucket, from the
copies committed beside this file; `seed capture` is what writes a
new version out of a developer's dev stack. Never hand-edit the
sizes or digests — regenerate them, or the loader refuses the copy.
Every object is synthetic and describes nobody. Nothing under
seeds/fixtures/ may ever hold a real person's document.
